description: Commission  of Elections - Elected Mr. Sena Dissanayake as Mayor of the Kandy Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Mayor in the Kandy Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for a local government position, including the resignation of the former mayor, the nomination process by a political party, and the official declaration of a new mayor. This content falls squarely under election-related matters and processes.
